summary: Enhance your skills with our Electronic Records and Information Management Training Course. Learn best practices for efficient data handling and compliance.
lede: Electronic records management helps governance, records, compliance and IT professionals control digital records through their lifecycle. Learners practice metadata and taxonomy design, file planning, retention scheduling, access controls, disposition workflows and eDiscovery preparation, including identifying and preserving responsive digital records and auditing compliance across enterprise systems.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for managing, securing, and governing digital information assets across enterprise systems.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of general office administration, IT systems, or compliance operations. No advanced programming or coding skills are required. Familiarity with basic document storage platforms (such as Microsoft SharePoint, Google Workspace, or shared network drives) is recommended to maximize the value of the hands-on configuration exercises.
